surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the adsorption of titanium isopropoxide (Ti(OCH(CH3)2)4) and water (H2O) on the substrate, followed by a surface reaction where the titanium isopropoxide reacts with water to form titanium dioxide (TiO2) and isopropyl alcohol (CH3CH2OH). The reaction is self-controlled and limited by the surface reactions rather than mass transport, ensuring a layer-by-layer growth.
